subject: forklift
label: forklift.mdl, in the place of the game's models/forklift.mdl

measured.lineup: ours is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/sat_globe.mdl, models/fungus.mdl, models/bm_leg.mdl: the judge does not know which

M1.reason: The outline reads as a forklift in every view: a tall two-upright mast with a crossbar rising above the roof (LEFT, RIGHT), two fork tines at low height (LEFT, TOP), an overhead guard with four posts, and a rear counterweight block (LEFT, BACK). The forks sit about 24 units above the deck, which fits 'raised a little'. The chassis reads thin and light rather than heavy, but the brief's words are met.

M2.reason: Measured 187 x 60 x 113 against the brief's 187 long, 60 wide and 113 high: sizeOff is 0 on every axis.

M3.reason: Parts the brief asks for, checked down to the small ones: a driver with head, torso and seat (LEFT, FRONT-LEFT); a white steering disc at the driver's chest (FRONT-LEFT, FRONT-RIGHT); a mast with two uprights, top and bottom crossbars and a back panel (FRONT, LEFT); two fork tines (TOP, BELOW); four wheels, two front and two rear (FRONT, BELOW); an overhead guard with four posts and a roof (FRONT, LEFT); a rear counterweight (BACK, TOP). None of the small parts the brief does not name (hydraulic rams, chains, headlight, arms) is charged, since the brief does not ask for them.

M4.reason: Yellow painted body and canopy as asked, grey metal mast and forks, black tyres, a blue-suited driver with a skin-toned head. Each region has a plausible colour and material for a warehouse forklift.

M5.reason: Faces are flat colour with no panel lines, grille, lettering or wear. The only markings are the black-and-yellow hazard stripes on the rear block (back, left and right views), which the brief does not ask for. Detail is thin for a heavy industrial machine.

M6.reason: In the line-up (C) it is recognisable as a forklift. Next to the three Valve props (A, B, D) it is clean, flat-faced and boxy, and the driver is a blocky figure. A player would probably not take it for one of the game's props. Its colours and wheels are close enough that the score is not 0.

M7.reason: Forks and driver face the same way, forward to the mast. It is upright and the wheels sit on the floor in the front, back and side views, with the origin at the base as a prop would have it.

M8.reason: SMAK checkErrors is empty. Triangles are 516, under the 576 limit (twice the median of Half-Life's props of this size, 288). Nothing in the views looks open or floating, though the views alone cannot prove the mesh is closed.
